title: pleurothallis integrilabia
intro: Pleurothallis integrilabia, commonly known as the "Coral Root", is a species of orchid plant that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. The Coral Root is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate various health conditions. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and exhibit neuroprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of Pleurothallis integrilabia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
